issues.description: The member 'width' of class Bitmap24 has a different type in the template and in the solution. In the template header 'width' is declared as short, while in the solution header it is declared as int. This cross-repository type discrepancy can confuse students who compare the template to the reference solution and may lead to subtle portability/size assumptions when using width in calculations or interfacing with other code (e.g., constructors that take int parameters).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of Bitmap24::width consistent across template and solution. Prefer using 'int' (matching the constructor parameter types and the solution header) in both example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp and any other headers so students see a single canonical type and avoid confusion.
